column1: # SEC-03: ZAP alerts reviewed, one per line: <plugin id>\t<reason>. Medium: accepted with a reason; High: only a verified "False positive (F-…)" with a findings row.

column2: False positive (F-AUTH-3): boolean SQLi on POST /api/auth/login. The two payloads got different answers because the login limiter switched from 401 to 429 mid-scan; every query is a Drizzle bound parameter (no sql.raw), and TC-SEC-04-8b shows identical 401s.

Accepted (F-WEB-12): the flagged forms carry WordPress/WooCommerce nonces under their own names (woocommerce-login-nonce, woocommerce-lost-password-nonce, woocommerce-process-checkout-nonce) that ZAP does not know; add-to-cart only changes a guest cart; store cookies are SameSite=Lax (F-WEB-10).

Accepted (F-WEB-13): the store CSP only restricts framing, plugins, <base> and form targets. WordPress block themes and WooCommerce Blocks emit inline scripts and styles, so a script-src/style-src policy would need unsafe-inline and add no XSS protection; nonce-based CSP for WordPress is out of scope (residual risk in SECURITY_REPORT).
